newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Lime says to sell assets to Highway.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Lime says to sell assets to Highway.

text.p: United States Lime & Minerals Inc said on Wednesday that it has agreed to sell substantially all of thes assets of its subsidiary Corson Lime Co to Highway Materials Inc.
The Corson sale is currently expected to close before the end of June, the company said in a statement.

"The sale will enable us to focus our energies and resources on our recently announced plans to modernize and expand our Texas and Akansas plants," said Lime and Minerals chief executive Robert Kizer.
Lime and Minerals manufactures lime and limestone products.
Highway Materials is a construction materials company affiliated with the DePaul Group.
